title: Our List of the 8 Best Membership Marketing Strategies to Attract and Retain Answers

facts.fact: The EventsAir blog article 'Here's Our List of 8 Best Membership Marketing Strategies to Attract and Retain Members' was published by Caitlin Ryan on November 6, 2025.
The article lists eight membership marketing strategies, per its title.
facts.quote: Here’s Our List of 8 Best Membership Marketing Strategies to Attract and Retain Members

facts.fact: EventsAir's site banner promoting AirTime Sydney says registration closes on Monday, 9 November.
facts.quote: Last chance for AirTime Sydney. Registration closes Monday, 9 November.

facts.fact: In its referral-program example, the article suggests tiered rewards in which one referral earns a branded mug, three referrals unlock discounted event tickets, and five referrals lead to VIP conference access; these are illustrative examples, not benchmarks.
facts.value: 1 referral = branded mug; 3 = discounted event tickets; 5 = VIP conference access
facts.quote: one referral might earn a branded mug, three might unlock discounted event tickets, and five might lead to VIP access at your annual conference

facts.fact: The article's sample referral callout suggests offering 25% off next year's dues to members who bring a friend; this is illustrative copy, not a reported result.
facts.quote: “Don’t forget, bring a friend and get 25% off next year’s dues,”

facts.fact: The article's sample limited-time promotion copy offers 20% off for prospects who join by the 15th; this is illustrative copy, not a reported result.
